additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause :
Problem Description :The customer reported that the power during the charging session on DC2 is fluctuating. After checking the session  we can see that the power delivery between the charger and the EV is changing frequently and is not stable
From the logs it appears that the charger is following the EV’s charging request but the requested power is varying significantly which causes the power output to fluctuate
Could you please confirm if that normal or not
